kind: audit diagnostic (not a claim, not used to move any number)
question: the thin shell (tsh 1.0) share of the verified gate: the pre-registered pick worn at tsh 1.5 (the parent family shell) vs tsh 1.0 (control)
script:
"""Audit diagnostic (not a claim): the thin shell's share. Claim model UNCHANGED, own exact Bench(110,360) prepare,
wear the pre-registered pick with tsh 1.5 (the parent's shell) and then tsh 1.0 (the pick, control)."""
import importlib.util, json, os, sys, time
REPO = "/home/user/exo-shoulder"; sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(REPO, "tools"))
os.environ["CB_EXACT"] = "1"
sp = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("phi40_aud", os.path.join(REPO, "docs/concepts/models/phi40-thinstack-relay-4r.py"))
OM = importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp); sp.loader.exec_module(OM)
PICK = json.load(open(os.path.join(REPO, "docs/concepts/verify/phi40-thinstack-relay-4r/pick.json")))
BASE = dict(OM.CLAIM_PARENT, **OM.HW0)
out = sys.argv[1]; t0 = time.time()
S = OM.prepare(BASE, 110, 360, exact=True)
res = dict(prepared=round(time.time() - t0, 1), ideal=S["ideal"], pick=PICK, cells=[])
json.dump(res, open(out, "w"), indent=1); print("prepared", res["prepared"], flush=True)
for tag, ov in (("tsh1.5", dict(tsh=1.5)), ("control_tsh1.0", {})):
    hw = dict(BASE, **PICK.get("hw", PICK)); hw.update(ov)
    o = OM.wear(S, hw); s = OM.summary(o)
    cell = dict(tag=tag, override=ov, summary=s, secs=round(time.time() - t0, 1))
    res["cells"].append(cell); json.dump(res, open(out, "w"), indent=1, default=str)
    print(json.dumps(dict(tag=tag, gate=s.get("gate"), plain=s.get("plain"), ibc=s.get("ibc"), reach=s.get("reach"), ncon=s.get("ncon"), jams=s.get("jams"))), flush=True)
